[3] (ran2_tdoc_chunks R2-2211002, sim=0.6834)
Based on the discussion in the previous sections we propose the following: Proposal 1: RAN2 to discuss whether RAN4's answer to Q1 in the LS is aligned with RAN2's agreements made in RAN2#117-e meeting. Proposal 2: The CR R2-2210659 is not pursued. Proposal 3: RAN2 assumes that extending the meaning of dualPA-Architecture capability in TS 38.306 from Rel-15 as proposed in R4-2206503 is backward compatible (can be revisited if needed based on P1 or issues are found).

[4] (ran2_tdoc_chunks R2-2106419, sim=0.6825)
At RAN2-113e meeting RAN2 discussed followings and Proposal 1 is agreed. As noted above, three options are still on the table, and RAN2 should discuss whether to support any of three options. As companies have different level of acceptance for each option, it is not worth to discuss unmeasurable aspects, e.g. whether option X is feasible or not, whether spec impact of option X is big or small, whether option X supports required level of reliability or not, etc. Instead, this document summarizes the essential technical issues of each option brought up by the companies. Whether the brought up issues are real issues or not need to be verified by RAN2.

[7] (ran2_tdoc_chunks R2-1807638, sim=0.6759)
This paper is the revision of R2-1804997. Some potential directions for enhancement are suggested according to the scope identified during the email discussion after RAN2#101bis. In RAN#75, the study item of NR based access to unlicensed spectrum[1] was agreed. In the RAN1#92 meeting, the following deployment scenarios were agreed to be studied. During the email discussion [2] after the RAN2#101bis, the scope of the RAN2 work is discussed. And it seems most companies take part in the discussion agree the following procedures need to be studied in the SI: system information, paging, DRX, RACH, Cross carrier HARQ, IDC, RLM, etc. In this contribution, we discuss the potential RAN2 impact of the above procedures.
